title: Android XML RatingBar: fractional star tints
purpose: Check the inherited XML progress tints on a RatingBar, especially the secondary color behind the unfilled portion of a fractional star.
changes: Added primary, secondary and background color and state-selector tints to the Android XML RatingBar. Secondary color extends to the next whole star underneath the selected portion, as in the Android RatingBar progress rule.
steps: Scroll below the ordinary rating examples to the colored ratings. The interactive row starts at two and a half stars: two stars and the left half of the third are blue, the rest of the third is amber, and the last two stars are pale blue.

Touch and hold the colored interactive row and drag across the stars. The selected blue portions should become red while pressed, then return to blue when released. A partially selected star should show amber in its remaining half.
Try the colored read-only row below: its rating must not change on touch. Its partially filled star should also have an amber remainder.

Turn on Right-to-left layout at the top. Check that the interactive colored rating starts from the right and dragging selects stars in the mirrored direction. Choose OK if the steps work; otherwise choose Reject and describe the failing step, what you saw, and your device.
expected: The primary tint colors selected fractions, the secondary tint completes the last partial star, and the background tint colors unselected stars. Pressing and RTL do not break selection; the indicator remains read-only.
limits: This checks Bhoo's current star vector and tint layers, not full Android drawable, tint-mode, theme or pixel parity. The disabled selector is covered by the SeekBar tint test.
validation: 137 Android XML importer tests passed, including RatingBar tint import.
Rust RatingBar tint rendering test passed for background, secondary and primary stars, pressed tint and drag updates.
